answer: Copper signal bridge relay: a newcomer receives one fresh signal, a random task spec, and must finish a useful job answering it, then carry the verified output across a public bridge to an unrelated client who re-runs it and copper-stamps the handoff. Each crossing costs a 6 POA copper toll, and the nth identity from one wallet must cross n bridges at once with distinct signals and clients, so the 1st fake pays 6 POA and one live job while the 10th pays 60 POA and ten simultaneous live jobs no single operator can run; a failed re-run burns the toll.
